## ✅ Quality & Security Checklist

- [ ] **Tests:** Unit tests added or updated in `tests/`.
- [ ] **Test Execution:** All unit tests pass locally (`uv run --no-sync pytest`).
- [ ] **Linting:** Code passes ruff check with zero warnings (`uv run --no-sync ruff check .`).
- [ ] **Formatting:** Code formatted with ruff (`uv run --no-sync ruff format .`).
- [ ] **Security:** No secrets, credentials, or private keys included in commits.
- [ ] **Paths:** No absolute local machine file paths in code or documentation.
- [ ] **Documentation:** Updated relevant documentation in `docs/` or `README.md`.
